div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 456px; height: 1px; padding-top: 1273px; margin-left: 278px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ededed); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Append-Only, Hash-Chained Audit Log▸ Alert Parameters (all fields)
▸ Operator Response (confirm / dismiss / escalate / timeout)
▸ Timestamp (precise)
▸ prev_hash → entry_hash (tamper-evident chain, Art. 12)
▸ Late response after timeout: timeout outcome stands;
late decision appended as separate annotated entry (never overwrites)
▸ Available for post-decision review by authorized oversight groups
